name: dream-eater
title: Dream Eater
description: Toggle sleep prevention, set an hours/minutes/seconds timer, and check verified status from compact Raycast commands.
author: christopher_fathallah

commands.name: dream-eater
commands.title: Toggle Dream Eater
commands.subtitle: Enable for 1 hour · or Disable
commands.description: Enable closed-lid sleep protection for one hour on charger or battery power, or restore normal sleep. Requires administrator approval.

commands.name: set-duration
commands.title: Dream Eater for…
commands.subtitle: Hours · Minutes · Seconds
commands.description: Keep awake with the lid closed on charger or battery power for an inline hours/minutes/seconds duration, up to 24 hours. Requires administrator approval.

commands.name: status
commands.title: Dream Eater Status
commands.subtitle: Check actual state · no background polling
commands.description: Read and verify Dream Eater status. The root subtitle records the time of this observation.

scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run lint:code
scripts.prepublishOnly: node -e "console.error('This is a Raycast extension. Do not publish it to npm. See docs/STORE.md.'); process.exit(1)"
